text: This may sound crazy, but I’ve never written a review before, this is my first! That’s how good this app is. I tried like 10 habit tracker apps, but this one? Instantly knew it’s the one. text: Very plain and simple, app looks minimal but with problems. The problem lies with the statistics, which is incorrectly calculated, some bugs there that the developer needs to sort out.
